note: Excerpt of the local Windows System event log around the R1v part 2 run, extracted after the review of 03ccf6c (which did not have it), on 2026-09-29, with Get-WinEvent: LogName System, 01:15 to 10:45 local time (+09:00), Kernel-Power 506 and 507, and Power-Troubleshooter 1 (none of the latter in the window). 506 is the system entering modern standby, 507 leaving it. The run record holds no clock time; the times below place it.
extracted_with: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; StartTime='2026-09-29 01:15'; EndTime='2026-09-29 10:45'}, filtered to Kernel-Power 506/507 and Power-Troubleshooter 1

run_timing.record_file_written_note: a file time, which git does not keep
run_timing.timer_started_note: the record file time less the wall clock; the record leaves about 37 s of the run untimed, so times placed from it are ranges
run_timing.process_start_listed_note: from a process listing taken at 02:59:34 during the run (process 60044), before the script timer started; that listing is not saved
